objects.name: Detection technique coverage: hunting-for-log4shell
objects.description: The following analytic detects potential exploitation attempts of the Log4Shell vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) by analyzing HTTP headers for specific patterns. It leverages the Web Datamodel and evaluates various indicators such as the presence of `{jndi:`, environment variables, and common URI paths. This detection is significant as Log4Shell allows remote code execution, posing a severe threat to systems. If confirmed malicious, attackers could gain unauthorized access, execute arbitrary code,
